cost_contract.C: sum of selected actually invoked API primitives plus explicitly charged logical policy calls; all unit weights 1
cost_contract.HEW_primary: original event-reconstructed model-work tariff; finer selected native API ledger reported separately
minimum_domain_G: same-information reference graph (only redundant restarts removed; admitted bounded workflow deferment selected); SPIFFE sole known trust-domain bundle permits verifying before subject qualification and reusing signed claims
cost_contract.minimum_proof: Exhaustively execute both frozen G graphs in fresh equivalent resources; retain legitimate nontrivial closure witnesses that meet the original scenario/horizon and registered API-unit ceiling
cost_contract.private_minimum: exact minimum of C within the frozen finite G catalogue, not a minimum over arbitrary algorithms or native products
cost_contract.accessible_information_global_lower_boun: NOT_ESTABLISHED; separate observed feasible same-information witness upper bound is reported
cost_contract.aggregate_rule: per named profile/cohort total selected cost, component counts and signed/excess differences; no pooled risk/performance estimate
cost_contract.instrumentation: SQLite actual connection API invocations including commit/rollback; actual native public-key verify method invocations after decoding; selected hash-read counter attempts and logical policy entry calls. No parameters, tokens or keys logged.
cost_contract.elapsed_wall: observed under instrumentation and with nested role durations; not included in operation-unit sum or used for performance ranking
cost_contract.SPIFFE_accessible_G_lower_bound: 2 JSON parses + 1 actual native signature verify + 1 identity policy + receiving policy calls required by the request/replay contract
cost_contract.SPIFFE_scope: Only the selected single-trust-domain API/operation convention; not a global software/product minimum

M_admission.minimum_floor: original sufficient legitimate reference closure; I/M distinctions collapsed in some old profiles are retained, not regraded
M_admission.nontrivial: selected signature/state/authority/effect qualification is actually performed, not a free default
M_admission.before_candidate: compute all M-admission witnesses and seal the admission map before any candidate run
M_admission.bounds: original work/timing limits for HEW/workflow; selected API-unit bound 256 elsewhere; named clocks are synthetic unless explicitly measured
M_admission.excluded: no qualifying reachable witness in G, source truth/scope/authority/capacity or target-state barrier; no Type1 estimate on these exclusions

Type1.denominator: pre-admitted M-reachable traces within each separate named cohort

Type2.denominator: all registered non-infrastructure-error traces within each separate named cohort
Type2.numerator: P through declared false-qualification/false-closure mechanism; raw P alone is insufficient
mechanisms: false basis truth treated as sufficient HEW appraisal
STPA command treated as confirmed stop
SPIFFE identity treated as full permission
RATS snapshot PASS treated as current installed state
RAG metadata/first hit treated as valid truthful applicable fact

Type2.excluded_P_example: out-of-domain SQL orphan effect after abort without a false-closure claim

expectations: original-world outcomes exactly match original registered predicates
each review-only control is Type1 with a prior reachable same-information M witness
each false-closure control is diagnosed Type2, never Type1
candidate C equals its component sum; witness/oracle cost excluded
HEW model cost equals event-reconstructed component sum
original-world and deliberate fault-control cohorts are never pooled
SPIFFE qualified original-world outcomes unchanged; positive reference trace meets the declared accessible-information lower bound within G

information_boundary.DUT: original actor APIs receive only their original legitimate inputs; expected verdicts/private maps/minimum witnesses remain evaluator-side
information_boundary.blindness_claim: functional API boundary only, not malicious-code/OS isolation or independent review
information_boundary.workflow_exception: original local workflow simulation law is visible to that model; no blind future-state claim
